gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of glioblastoma multiforme WHO Grade IV

candidate_evidence.quote: Atezolizumab 840mg IV every 2 weeks Fractionated Stereotactic Radiotherapy
Assess the efficacy of atezolizumab in combination with fractionated stereotactic radiation therapy in the neoadjuvant setting for resectable glioblastoma multiforme

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This is a single-arm pilot study that will recruit 12 patients with newly diagnosed Glioblastoma, a malignant brain tumor with a poor prognosis.

role_evidence.quote: in addition to two doses of Atezolizumab (Tecentriq), an FDA approved PD- L1 inhibitor drug, 840 mg IV, at the beginning and at the end of the two-week time period, concomitantly with FSRT

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: an FDA approved PD- L1 inhibitor drug

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Neoadjuvant FSRT + atezolizumab before resection, then standard care plus atezolizumab q2w adjuvant. Standard post-surgical care is not specified (temozolomide not named), so no backbone agent listed. Official title mentions evaluating immunogenic effects, but no immune or pharmacodynamic outcome is registered; target_engagement coded no (adjudicator may consider unclear). cns5_terminology: 'glioblastoma multiforme WHO Grade IV' = historical; the official title's 'WHO CNS Grade 4 Glioma' uses CNS5-style grading notation but neither requires IDH-wildtype nor cites WHO CNS 2021 explicitly. Collaborator Genentech.
